# Tested preview packages

[Download the v6 preview ZIP](SignalAnalysis-preview-2026-11-13-v6.zip) ([SHA-256](SignalAnalysis-preview-2026-11-13-v6.zip.sha256)) for the tested 13 November 2026 build. It includes the on-screen tape file picker, autonomous loading spinner, completed data-block counter, source, preassembled programs, documentation, tests, and sample media. Unpack the archive into your installation's FunStuff directory, preserving any existing SignalAnalysis installation first. Run make check before rebuilding or editing.

The archive is a complete SignalAnalysis directory. Its own integrity manifest excludes this dist directory. Machine-specific core snapshots, tape assignments and runtime state are excluded.

The [v4 preview](SignalAnalysis-preview-2026-11-12-v4.zip) remains available as the historical 12 November build; it predates the picker and loading indicators.
